EV classification Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are classified into three groups typically based on their size and biogenesis: exosomes (30–200 nm), microvesicles (MVs) (100–1000 nm) and apoptotic bodies (> 1000 nm) [ 5 , 21 – 24 ] (Fig. 1 ).
EVs produced directly from outward plasma membrane budding are classified as ectosomes/MVs and display a size range from 50 nm to 1 µm [ 2 , 37 ].

Advanced fractionation separated exosomes by their size, classifying them as large exosomes (90–120 nm) or small exosomes (60–80 nm) [ 97 ], while additional density centrifugation separated high and low density exosomes [ 175 ].
